record.rationale: Retain final generic FUSE-BPF Android protocol/configuration/backing implementation, positively consumed by local MediaProvider, fuseMedia and BPF loader. Adapt the 34-path historical foundation onto native 6.18.57 instead of replaying obsolete FUSE internals; omit ARM64-only config and removed ownership metadata. Native verifier, bpf_prog_load, virtio-fs and moved conversion helpers are preserved; native I/O release, rdev encoding and ordinary idmapped getattr restored. Correct unsafe context/argument exposure with bounded private scratch, full pointer loads, read-only input types and bounded output copyback; add allocation/error cleanup, rename lock handling and ordinary-open rejection release. Keep live userspace UAPI, sysfs discovery and source interfaces without historical KMI wrappers. Explicit limits: 64 KiB maximum verified access per argument (larger returns E2BIG), incomplete iterator/prefilter rewrite coverage, compat backing ioctl ENOTTY, no general backing idmap guarantee, dynamic backing replacement and mixed-cache/mmap concurrency unverified. No claim of complete runtime parity or security certification. Final source selection is complete with these limits; actual SDK property/use and optional no_daemon behavior remain unverified. Optional selftest fixtures retained by final-source comparison, not executed. Supporting earlier FUSE history/local reviews and new extracted-code checks cover the adaptations; final full emulator workflow is recorded separately.

path_decisions.rationale: Retain actual feature/program-type discovery documentation. The dynamic program-type number is consumed by the local Android BPF loader; this is userspace protocol, not historical vendor-module binary KMI.
Omit this ARM64 configuration addition for the selected x86_64 SDK target. This does not assert that ARM64 Android does not need FUSE-BPF.

Retain CONFIG_FUSE_BPF=y with FUSE_FS/BPF_SYSCALL/BPF_JIT enabled in the actual SDK build. Generic optional Android behavior is retained without requiring proof that the current SDK property enables it at runtime.
Retain the FUSE_BPF selection and its FUSE_FS/BPF dependency; the delivered SDK also enables BPF_SYSCALL. No certification of every optional Kconfig combination.
Add the backing object conditionally and retain native DAX/passthrough/io_uring objects.
Remove __exit from cleanup because BPF cache initialization can fail after control initialization and must unwind it from the init error path; no control permission change.

Retain BPF error transport, zero-nodeid forget suppression and daemon-context acquisition/validation of replacement file/program handles. Preserve native reply bounds, connection/request lifetime and canonical-path checks; prior FUSE review covers reference cleanup and stacking restrictions. Native extension length and BPF error share a protocol union, with distinct ordinary/BPF requests; simultaneous native extensions and BPF error transport is not claimed.

Adapt lookup/create/rename/link/access/attribute/symlink/directory operations to native VFS signatures and existing BPF pre/backing/post dispatch. Preserve native attribute conversion, idmap for ordinary getattr and error behavior; RCU-only calls retry with ECHILD. Hold an alias for internal backing attribute refresh or return ESTALE. Lookup/replacement lifetime and generic idmapped backing remain explicitly limited.

Retain BPF backing open/read/write/flush/fsync/seek/fallocate/copy/mmap/splice dispatch around native FUSE paths. Restore native final-reference I/O-mode release instead of losing cached/uncached/passthrough accounting. BPF ordinary-open rejection frees backing state before VFS owns it; atomic create retains VFS ownership. Existing mixed-cache and incomplete payload-filtering limitations remain.

Retain generic Android backing operations, using native VFS permission/LSM helpers and adapted native APIs. Bound BPF buffers through verifier maximum-access metadata, private prefilter copies, exact aliases and bounded output copyback; clean initialization allocations on fallback/errors. Fix lookup/reply references, negative xattr length, statfs extent, rename ERR_PTR/unlock, open failure and RCU symlink cases. Preserve native lower operations rather than import historical implementations. 64 KiB per-argument verified-access ceiling and zero padding are deliberate safety changes. Lower idmapped stacking, dynamic replacement races, full payload filtering and mixed mmap/cache correctness are not certified.

Retain backing state/prototypes and dispatch with native fields, without KABI layout wrappers. Move four native helper bodies without semantic changes; shared attribute finalization preserves caller idmap. Validate argument counts, clean initialized resources on fallback/pre/post errors and retain negative errors through finalization. Adapt request storage to native args.h split.

Retain discovery sysfs, root backing/program and no_daemon options, inode/dentry reference ownership and BPF cache initialization/unwind. Preserve whole native fuse_init_inode including encoded rdev; encode producer rather than alter native decoder. Validate root options and duplicate replacement ownership; no_daemon disconnects absent request transport before INIT allocation. Ordinary native allocation guards are preserved. No optional no_daemon runtime guarantee.

Retain independent backing ioctl dispatch and native ioctl logic. Compat backing returns ENOTTY as in selected ACK; this is an existing limitation, not proof that compat users do not exist. The backing bypass is not claimed to execute BPF policy on each ioctl.

Retain backing iteration dispatch alongside native directory-cache/readdir implementation; release temporary page centrally on all initialized outcomes. Actual daemon filtering/iteration and races are not runtime-tested.

Retain backing get/list/set/remove dispatch, preserving lower VFS/LSM checks and native FUSE fallback. Negative get results remain errors before size conversion. Existing operations that ignore rewritten prefilter arguments are documented rather than claimed fully implemented.
Register the custom program type only with FUSE_BPF; preserve existing native type registrations.

Retain ACK argument layout, opcodes/flags and backing/program replacement actions, positively used by MediaProvider and fuseMedia. Context metadata stays read-only; pointer-valued fields receive verified buffer types, unused slots point to zeroed scratch and end_offset remains zero.
Append FUSE program type without renumbering existing upstream types. Android loader discovers its actual value from sysfs; historical fixed numeric compatibility is not imposed.

Retain native protocol additions and use the ACK error_in/total_extlen union, with zero default error for ordinary requests and native extlen assignment for extensions. This preserves live daemon protocol, not obsolete module ABI layout. Canonical-path opcode is separately reviewed.
Build custom verifier/attachment support under FUSE_BPF and BPF_SYSCALL; preserve native build rules.

Retain restricted helper set and program-file/type validation with consumed file reference on all valid-input paths. Replace unsafe ACK context access check with full bounds/alignment and whole pointer loads; input pointers are read-only. Generic native verifier and native bpf_prog_load authorization are unchanged.
Only include Android context UAPI for the conditional type definition; native BTF implementation otherwise remains unchanged.
